name: Taughannock Falls State Park
blurb: 215ft plunge, taller than Niagara. Flat 0.75mi gorge trail to the base.

name: Robert H. Treman State Park
blurb: Swim at the base of Lower Falls. Gorge trail passes 12 waterfalls.

name: Watkins Glen State Park
blurb: 19 waterfalls in 2 miles of stone stairs and tunnels. The famous one.

name: Cascadilla Gorge Trail
blurb: Six waterfalls climbing from downtown Ithaca up to Cornell. Short and steep.

name: Ithaca Farmers Market
blurb: Waterfront pavilion at Steamboat Landing. Sat 9-3, Sun 10-3. Food stalls, not just produce.

name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
blurb: Free. Herb garden, arboretum, and the Slim Jim Woods trails.

name: Stewart Park
blurb: Cayuga Lake shoreline, carousel, big shade trees. Easy with no plan.

name: Lime Hollow Nature Center
blurb: Boardwalks, bog, treehouse. Closest real nature to the Airbnb.

name: Greek Peak Mountain Coaster
blurb: Alpine coaster you control. Also a zipline and adventure center.

name: Cayuga Lake Wine Trail
blurb: Tasting rooms up both shores. Sheldrake Point and Six Mile Creek are the easy picks.

name: Buttermilk Falls State Park
blurb: Swimming hole at the base plus the gorge climb. Already on the itinerary Friday.

name: Cornell Lab of Ornithology
blurb: Free. Bird cams, sound library, 4 miles of Sapsucker Woods trail outside.

name: Museum of the Earth
blurb: Full mastodon and a right whale skeleton. Good rain plan, about 2 hours.

name: Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art
blurb: Free. I.M. Pei building, and the 5th floor has the best view of Cayuga Lake.

name: Sciencenter
blurb: Hands-on science museum. Built for kids but the outdoor mini golf is fun regardless.

name: Center Ithaca / Ithaca Commons
blurb: Food court with the soup dumplings, plus the pedestrian mall shops.

name: Cortland Beer Company
blurb: Small taproom downtown Cortland. Closest good beer to the Airbnb.

name: Purity Ice Cream
blurb: Ithaca institution since 1936. The other dairy option if the Cornell line is long.

name: 1890 House Museum
blurb: Chateau-style mansion with a tower you can climb. Right in Cortland.

name: Cortland Repertory Theatre
blurb: Summer stock at the Pavilion in Little York Lake. Check what is running.
